displayPattern: 7-segment display on a single-stage *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 furnace (IOG-2037B): E11
diySteps: Technician: check for correct gas pressure
Technician: check for correct burner alignment
Technician: check for and correct burner restriction
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: a tripped rollout switch means flame left the burner area; do not keep resetting it. This code is on the single-stage *R9S96, *D9S96 and *R9S92 chart in IOG-2037B (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide). It is not a *CVC96 or *MVC96 code from IOG-2015L.
